Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, classrooms, specialized spaces, and site plans (Appendices B, C). Robust condition assessment covering major systems and maintenance needs with prioritization and connection to long-term capital planning (Deficiencies Lists, Prioritization Process).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 10+ years with multiple scenarios and methodology explained (Appendix A). Capacity analysis by site, room, and program with national standards comparison and explicit connection to facility actions including expansions and new construction (Facility Capacity Analysis, Enrollment Research & Projections).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan references educational goals and connects facility projects to specific programs such as CTE, STEM, and special education (Deficiencies Lists, Project Concepts). Educational specifications are detailed but integration with instructional priorities is partial, lacking a fully comprehensive educational alignment section.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Outdoor spaces are described mainly as athletic fields and playgrounds with some mention of shade trees and site improvements (Deficiencies Lists, Amenities for Extra-Curricular Activities). Limited data or districtwide analysis on greening, canopy cover, or stormwater management; no explicit climate resilience framing.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges maintenance and stormwater management issues but lacks a comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed climate resilience strategies. Climate readiness is not a central theme in the plan.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions HVAC replacements and LED lighting upgrades as part of maintenance and capital projects (Project Groupings, Deficiencies Lists). No comprehensive energy use data or detailed strategies for electrification, decarbonization, or energy resilience; no explicit reference to state mandates.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed multi-phase capital strategy with itemized cost estimates, prioritization framework, and multiple funding sources including bonds, PPEL, and sales tax (Financial Analysis, Appendix D). Includes risk considerations, debt capacity analysis, and alignment with district priorities.
